technologies.name: Timeless Temple Blueprints
technologies.description: The complex structure seems to have 3 rotating elements. It should not be too difficult to replicate. Still, something about this construct seems timeless and unnatural.

technologies.name: Chrono Celebration
technologies.description: A new method for using Zro. This will enhance our cultural delights and boost the moral of our people.

technologies.name: Chrono Components
technologies.description: A new method for integrating Zro into our fleets. Specific alignment to the flow of time can increase the resistance of our ships to disruptive forces and give new options for objects to skip over large distances instantly.

technologies.name: Chrono Construction
technologies.description: A new method for applying Zro over large areas. A perfectly timed, continuous pulse could increase our scientist's output significantly.

technologies.name: Rune Golem Mastery
technologies.description: The final piece of lost knowledge our ancestors and makers once held. Now the time to remake ourselves has come.

unlocks.name: Unlocks Trait: - Rune-Forged Excellence - Runic Encryption - Rune Vision

technologies.name: Ancient Leviathan Incubation
technologies.description: Specialised hatcheries for clones of the Hoarding Dragon.

technologies.name: Zarkin Doctrine
technologies.description: Indeed otherwise known as the Doctrine of Fear, the doctrine was rooted in Zarkin's theory of "Rule by Fear" the contention that overwhelming displays of force, rather than force itself, were the most effective means of maintaining internal security and the loyalty of vassal worlds.

technologies.name: Sacred Apprenticeship
technologies.description: Younger generation need to learn, before they can master the arts of runesmithing.

technologies.name: Planetary Halo
technologies.description: Massive structures in close orbit to the planet supporting local infrastructure and logistics.

technologies.name: Bio-Shaping
technologies.description: A twisted art to manipulate organic tissue into different shapes and forms.

technologies.name: Mining Crews
technologies.description: Mechanised space suits able to mine deep under the crust of lifeless planets and uncover new deposits.

unlocks.name: Unlocks Starbase Building: Deep Space Mining Rig

technologies.name: Null Fields
technologies.description: Fields specialised in neutralising connections between real-space and the shroud.

unlocks.name: Unlocks Trait: - Extra Limb - Additional Eye - Hidden Tail

technologies.name: Geo-Centralizer
technologies.description: As a result of studying the Geocentric Device, we have caught glimpses of the potential to manipulate entire solar systems. It will turn the target planet into a barren world and make it the center of the system, rearranging all other bodies around it.

technologies.name: Weaponized Flux Projection
technologies.description: By opening the rift to the Neertean universe, we can let some flux into our universe, and when focused in a tight beam, those particles can be utterly devastating when interacting with the matter of our universe.

technologies.name: Flux Propulsion
technologies.description: A small amount of Flux can be drawn from the Neertean universe and used as a surprisingly effective means of propulsion.

technologies.name: Flux Confounders
technologies.description: A small amount of Flux, when thrown into the vacuum of space, will hopelessly confuse hostile targeting.

technologies.name: Rift Power Drawing
technologies.description: When carefully contained, Flux drawn from the Neertean universe can be used as fuel in our power plants.

technologies.name: Planetary Shields
technologies.description: Generating a strong energy shield within a planetary atmosphere is a greater challenge than in the vacuum of space, but it offers a potent defense against orbital bombardment.

technologies.description: Based on our own field manipulation research as well as our previous studies of precursor shield technology, a group of our scientists has put forward a promising design concept for an upgraded version of our own planetary shield generators.

technologies.name: Precursor Shield Maintenance
technologies.description: The technology behind this shield generator is far beyond our capabilities to recreate. That said, with our rudimentary understanding of it we will be able to disassemble and reassemble it whereever we see fit.

technologies.name: Crystal Cultivation
technologies.description: Advances in ecological adaption will allow us to seed new crystal fields within controlled environments. This process degrades the host planet's ecosystem, but damages will remain within acceptable parameters.

technologies.name: Crawler Physiology
technologies.description: The Crawler creature we picked up from an asteroid has very unusual physiology. But it should still be possible to conduct non-invasive studies without harming the creature and find out what makes it so unique.

technologies.name: Lunar Harnessing
technologies.description: Rebuilding our power generators to actively harness power based on lunar phases might improve their output.

technologies.name: Dragon Scale Hull Reinforcements
technologies.description: By fusing the artificially grown extra-tough dragon scales with our ships' hulls, we can significantly increase their resilience.

technologies.name: Secrets of the Alkree
technologies.description: The Alkree put a lot of their advanced data processing tech into the Surveyor Probe's design. Now it's ours.

technologies.name: Magnificent Apparatus
technologies.description: A giant labotary ready to produce Voggos en masse

technologies.description: Should not be seen

technologies.name: Xentronium Armor
technologies.description: This super dense material once provided Vazuran vessels with extreme durability. It is vastly superior to any other known armor types.

technologies.name: Voidborn Carapace Weak Spots
technologies.description: Facing the possibility of another swarm invasion, the only reasonable course of action is to prepare as well as we can. Having access to the collected specimens, our scientists will find whatever weakness these beasts might have - if they have one at all. We will need any edge we can get to protect what is rightfully ours should they ever return.

technologies.name: Xentronium Flux Space Manipulation
technologies.description: The continued research of super dense alloy known as Xentronium has led to bewildering experiments with flux field generators. Results show potential application in our ship's defences against penetrating rounds.

technologies.name: Xentronium Drone Designs
technologies.description: Drones supplied by Vazuran wreckages show a unique opportunity to incorparte state of the art drone technology and kinetic weaponry.
